input: Set up a cloud backup for all home documents

gold.taskTitle: Set Up Cloud Backup for Home Documents
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to configure a cloud backup system to protect all of their home documents.

questions.title: Which cloud service are you considering using?
questions.description: Identify the preferred cloud provider, such as Google Drive, iCloud, OneDrive, Dropbox, or Backblaze.

questions.title: What operating system is your home computer running?
questions.description: Determine whether the user is on Windows, macOS, Linux, or another OS, as this affects setup steps.

questions.title: How much data in total needs to be backed up?
questions.description: Estimate the total size of all home documents to determine what storage plan is needed.

questions.title: What types of files count as your home documents?
questions.description: Clarify whether documents include only text files, or also photos, videos, spreadsheets, PDFs, and similar files.

questions.title: Do you want backups to run automatically or manually?
questions.description: Determine whether the user wants a scheduled, continuous, or on-demand backup process.

questions.title: How often should the backup refresh or sync?
questions.description: Define the backup frequency, such as real-time syncing, hourly, daily, or weekly updates.

questions.title: Is security or encryption a priority for these backups?
questions.description: Find out whether the user needs end-to-end encryption or has privacy concerns that affect the choice of service.
